steps.text: A standoff.

It was meant to be a sudden assault. The casters of Kreis Heldenschwert would disguise themselves as musicians and infiltrated the Witch King's Spire, while the armies from Erdenherre and Sturmland would stay hidden outside through their enchantments.
No one dared underestimate the Witch King's power, but the battle was nonetheless harder than anyone could have imagined.
The army outside the Spire was discovered by the Einwald Imperial Guard. The first wave of casters all died at its base, while the second wave was swallowed by the endless staircase.
The only ones who made it to the throne were the Twins. Grimmacht, and her sister, Ewigegnade.
Black and red had always been the Urtica colors, but from the entrance to its deepest innards, the Spire was almost completely void of black tiles.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: House Urtica's secret chamber lies underground, and it's very close to Sonata Spire, so we can make our way down through it. Herr Fremont has already left, and we must catch up.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: Nein.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Is something the matter?

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: Go no further.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: The Witch King's Imperial Guard is here. You will die.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: The Imperial Guard? What do you mean?

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: The folks from Heldenschwert never expected you people to win. They simply wanted the Sturmland armies to keep the Imperial Guard at bay while the Twins climbed the spire.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: In their plans, all of you were meant to die. The Witch King, the Twins, everyone.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: Tell your father and Ernst that the Hochbergs should not be buried here, not in this spire.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Herr Reiner, my father is dead.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: I'm the reason that you're the only survivor.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: I'm the one... who took away your freedom...

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Please, look at me. I'm Viviana.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Did you perhaps... mistake me for my father?

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: Leave now. Leave Ludwigs-Universität.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: Grimmacht's envoy has passed on the Kaiserin's order. As an Empresses' Voice, you have more than enough grounds to terminate your mission.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: And to prevent the Voices from going out of sync, Ewigegnade won't punish you for it either.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Do you hear the commotion around us?

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: It sounds familiar.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: This is practically a battlefield. My duties prevent me from escorting you out, but I can at least use my melody to forge a path through the chaos for you.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: ...Nein.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: I will never forget how quiet and peaceful it was when we entered the campus. The young students' faces still had hope for what was to come.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: I can't let them become sacrifices to this conflict.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: While I'm nowhere near as strong as you or Herr Fremont, I'd like to help as many of those weaker than me as I can.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: Herkunftshorn's secret lies ahead.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: Ewigegnade said that when Das Kaiserinnensfest comes to an end, you'll have another chance to choose.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: But once you've gazed upon the country's darkest, most hidden secret, all your other choices will immediately evaporate.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: I expected as much.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: But while I long for freedom, I can't very well turn my back on people suffering right in front of me.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Ironic, isn't it?

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: ...You're just like your father.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Ja, I know.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: I've... always known the kind of man he was.

steps.name: Gendarmerie A
steps.text: What's going on? Why are there so many people underground?

steps.name: Gendarmerie B
steps.text: They charged inside! It's not just Sonata Spire, either; The Scholars' Spire next door, too! There are students everywhere!

steps.name: Gendarmerie A
steps.text: Stop them all! Don't let them block the stairs, or we can't chase—

steps.name: Gendarmerie A
steps.text: Who did that?

steps.name: Gendarmerie B
steps.text: No idea, there's too much going on! I can't make anything out!

steps.name: Gendarmerie A
steps.text: W-Witch King's remnants!

steps.name: 'Witch King's Echo'
steps.text: Listen.

steps.name: 'Witch King's Echo'
steps.text: Listen to the extreme chaos, as well as to the only melody that can be found within it.

steps.name: 'Witch King's Echo'
steps.text: That is Herkunftshorn's sigh.

steps.name: 'Witch King's Echo'
steps.text: The final sound our king left upon this land.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: The supreme spire, whose dark shadow on the ground causes all to shudder.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Those who do not wish to be engulfed in darkness paddle their arms and climb the staircases leading up.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: The pitch black will hangs over the throne in silence, awaiting inquiries from other souls.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Those who hide behind the curtains regret the demise of love.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Those who lead the charge in others' stead ponder the meaning of heroism.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Those who wade through the sea of their fallen comrades' blood lament the price of their sacrifice.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: All of them now gather at the far ends of this spiral staircase, to witness the birth of this melody.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Its name—

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: —Der Tod des Hexenkönigs.

steps.name: Frightened Student
steps.text: It's the Witch King's army! They're charging toward me!

steps.name: Frightened Student
steps.text: Casters pouring in through Catastrophes! Originium piercing entire cities!

steps.name: Frightened Student
steps.text: Help, I don't want to die... But... I might as well. Please, burn me to ashes! I don't want to be crumpled into a living ball of flesh!

steps.name: Frightened Student
steps.text: Urk... Nngh!

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: How could you set yourself ablaze, you idiot!

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Nein, everyone here has gone mad!

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: This sound... Th-The pipe organ! Are the Witch King's remnants performing? All of us are under the influence of their... illusions...

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Who's there on the podium?

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: All this blood, all these... corpses? But who is it lying in the blood...?

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Grimmacht... Ewigegnade!

steps.name: Enraged Student
steps.text: Hahaha, it's you! The wicked Twins!

steps.name: Enraged Student
steps.text: The rumors were true, weren't they? Your souls were cooked up by Sarkaz Arts, and your blood molded from the ambitions of traitors!

steps.name: Enraged Student
steps.text: You killed Leithanien's true king, and took over her throne—

steps.name: Enraged Student
steps.text: You two were born to destroy this country!

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: You're wrong!

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Grimmacht may be cruel, but she's not evil!

steps.name: Enraged Student
steps.text: And who are you? Another Empresses' Voice? A puppet carrying out the Twins' will?

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Nein, she wouldn't let me become one.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: But I'm alive because of Grimmacht. I want to help her. I want to—

steps.name: Enraged Student
steps.text: Anyone who accepts a monster's reward becomes a monster themselves. Look at all this! Look at how far Leithanien has fallen because of you people!

steps.name: Enraged Student
steps.text: This spire... This school...

steps.name: Enraged Student
steps.text: Did you keep Ludwigs-Universität around only to impersonate us true Leithanians? To pretend you still had the decency to respect tradition?

steps.name: Enraged Student
steps.text: I've had enough. I'm sick of the Empresses' Voice showing up at our lectures. I'm sick of the salons incapable of anything other but empty praise!

steps.name: Enraged Student
steps.text: Our history, our knowledge, and our arts are all long dead. Murdered!

steps.name: Enraged Student
steps.text: So we may as well die together.

steps.name: Enraged Student
steps.text: I... I'll kill all of you...!

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Ugh—!

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: What are these Arts? Why can't I block them?

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: No... Is that a fist? I...
Michael's eyes suddenly widen.
More and more people rush toward Sonata Spire by the minute, joining the fray as the music continues. Many of them set down their wands, choosing instead of use their fists, legs, and teeth.
Is this still the Leithanien he knows?
All the rhetorical tricks and combat tactics he learned... even Originium Arts have lost their effectiveness.
Aside from cowering under his shield, there is nothing he can do. Right now, he is no different from the young boy he was when he had just left his hometown and arrived in Zwillingstürme.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Please, I beg you... Ewigegnade, I'll do anything... Please spare me...

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: No... Don't hurt me...

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Grimmacht... Grimmacht...
Please stand.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Who...?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Raise your shield, and face it to your left.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: ...Okay.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Help me hold this person up.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: A Gendarme? Who is he?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I do not know his name, but he is one of Loris Bordin's subordinates.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: He was attempting to blow my head up with Arts.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: And you still saved him?

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Ugh—!

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: The third sculpture, shattered.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: He was merely carrying out his duties. I see no reason to harm him.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: These men may be under the influence of Arts, losing their reason to their most intense emotions buried deep within their hearts.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Fighting them would be inefficient. I suggest instead quickly rendering them unconscious, as I have been doing.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: ...So this entire time, you've been knocking people out while making your way through the crowd?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I have also attempted to place them in a corner to ensure that they won't be stepped on or struck in the melee.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Danke, then, for not clubbing me the moment you saw me then.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I do not require thanks.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Micha Wolf, you may be young, but mentally you are much stronger than most adults.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I believe that as long as someone is available to provide you a hint, you will never lose yourself to these illusions.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: That is not necessarily the case for everyone else.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Although I have yet to receive confirmation, if it was Arturia's music that caused this chaos, then the abnormal behavior will continue until we end her performance.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I'll leave this place to you, Micha Wolf.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Call me Michael.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: I must continue ascending, Michael.

steps.name: Strange Voice From a Sculpture
steps.text: This sound is very familiar.

steps.name: Strange Voice From a Sculpture
steps.text: The staircase outside must be as chaotic as it was twenty-three years ago?

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Panic, anxiety, fear, rage... All these emotions, caused by that non-existent spire.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: The Genesis Spire standing at the heart of Leithanien.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: When its sound can once again be heard far and wide, what sort of music will it finally have in store for us?

steps.name: 'Witch King's Echo'
steps.text: Herkunftshorn, our one and only king!

steps.name: 'Witch King's Echo'
steps.text: Your magnificence props up the Spire, and your radiance shrouds the land!

steps.name: 'Witch King's Echo'
steps.text: Your soul shines eternal, and your Arts will never fade!

steps.name: 'Witch King's Echo'
steps.text: All of Leithanien's wisdom and elegance gather before you!

steps.name: 'Witch King's Echo'
steps.text: Your luminance and greatness are the pillars of her success!

steps.name: 'Witch King's Echo'
steps.text: Lift your heads, all ye who prostrate on the land before him—

steps.name: 'Witch King's Echo'
steps.text: Gaze upon our king's accomplishments! His glory!

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: At last... The day has finally arrived.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: For two decades, I've dreamt of walking up those long stairs and standing before this very throne.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Fortunately, fate provided me the enchantments you left on the Güldenesgesatz.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Today, very soon, your final melody will be performed.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Herkunftshorn, Leithanien's most supreme ruler.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Allow me to once again seek an audience.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Allow me to... seek your forgiveness.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Good boy, Franz.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: I apologize. I had no choice but to knock you out. Does your head still hurt?

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: I would have thought you'd have plenty of questions for me.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: ...Hah.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Ja, that's the look. You're in pain, but unwilling to give in. Even lying in sludge, you'd still look upon your betters with scorn.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: My betters? All I see is a flock of madmen putting on a show.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Your ramblings are even less worth listening to than the noise in my head.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: You believe us insane, and that we've mistaken you for the Witch King. And so we repent and kneel before you.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: What a shame. Even I had hoped that you could truly become him.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: If only... If only our original experiment had succeeded. If only we'd found the way to perform the Voice of Mundane right from the start.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Then, neither you nor the other children would have suffered so.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: ...It was you?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: And to think I was going to... protect you...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Ha... hahahaha!

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: You're coughing up blood.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: *spit*

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I almost wish my blood really were imbued with evil power. Then I could've at least burnt away that deceitful mask you're wearing.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: But I haven't told you a single lie.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: When we first met, you'd yet to learn to walk. All you could do was sit on your mother's lap.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Was she also...?

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: A remnant of the Witch King? Is that what you wanted to ask?

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Are you worried that your birth itself was... some sort of evil ritual?

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Nein, quite the opposite. But you wish it were, don't you? You want your entire life to have been a conspiracy, through-and-through. That way, you'd feel comfortable despising it.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: But that doesn't make sense, my dear Franz.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Your mother was a respectable woman. She was a descendant of the Urticas, part of the Witch King's bloodline. So to others, she was almost by definition one of his remnants.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Before she died, she entrusted you to a friend, an old servant of the Witch King. And to protect you, he too was killed by the Empresses' Voice.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Would you scorn them as well? Even though they truly loved you?

spans.text: as well? Even though they truly loved you?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: ...So after taking away my love, now you tell me I don't deserve to hate either?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: You want me to be nothing more than an empty husk. All the better to squeeze that old fart into me.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Hah... Just try.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: The Witch King's whispers, his robes, his crown... What else is there?

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Don't worry, my child.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: When Herkunftshorn's power arrives, he will end your cruel fate and heal you of your scars and pain.
I thought I told you to let him go.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: So you chased us after all.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: It must have been hard to make it past all the enchantments outside, no?

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: This is my responsibility, and I don't give up.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: I'm surprised you were able to cleave through my defensive enchantments.

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: I sharpen my sword with my Arts every day. I make sure that it's as solid as my will.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Your sword... It has a special enchantment that specifically targets traditional Leithanian Arts. Did the Professor teach you that? Has he always been prepared to make an enemy of Leithanien?

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: The old man's never been one to pick his enemies. And neither do I. Our enemies crawl out the shadows on their own.

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: Just like you, Gerhard.

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: I never expected to point my sword at someone who was once my ally.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: We don't have to be enemies, Lessing.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: The Maeyers have served the Urticas for generations.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: As long as you're willing to stand on our side and help Franz, there will always be a place for you by the throne.

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: The throne?

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: All I see is a musty old chair.

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: My grandfather, my parents... All of them have been held hostage by that chair for far too long.

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: Why should I repeat the same mistake and bind myself to it again?

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Hm, well said.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Those unwilling to be bound by the past will always try to seek out a different fate.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Like you, and like me.

steps.name: 'Witch King's Echo'
steps.text: The Concertmaster has started the performance.

steps.name: 'Witch King's Echo'
steps.text: It's almost time.

steps.name: 'Witch King's Echo'
steps.text: No one can stop the advent of Herkunftshorn anymore.

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: But Herkunftshorn isn't the one sitting on that throne.

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: His name is Ebenholz.

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: And it's my duty to bring him back with me.

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: As long as I live, nothing will stop me from reaching that battered chair.

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: It doesn't matter how many men you have—

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: Come at me.

steps.name: 'Witch King's Echo'
steps.text: Gesatzswächter...!

steps.name: 'Witch King's Echo'
steps.text: The melody has begun. Not even you can stop its flow!

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: Perhaps not.

steps.name: 'Witch King's Echo'
steps.text: Your sword is... reverberating?

steps.name: 'Witch King's Echo'
steps.text: It's useless, Gesatzswächter. You may be able to chain down a single man's mind, but a hundred? A thousand? Your melody will be drowned in chaos.

steps.name: 'Witch King's Echo'
steps.text: Much like how the Gesatzswächter were unable to stop the melee at the foot of the Witch King's Spire twenty-three years ago...

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: If so, I will kill chaos itself.
His longsword pierces not his enemy's chest, but instead the ground beneath them.
A golden radiance surges from the blade, drowning out even the Gesatzswächter's armor, then dashes toward the sky to form a webbing the color of the setting sun, enveloping Sonata Spire within it.
All sounds within reach of his Arts are drowned out, leaving nothing but the solemn melody reverberating in the air.

steps.name: 'Witch King's Echo'
steps.text: A golden curtain?

steps.name: 'Witch King's Echo'
steps.text: Those Arts should take at least ten Gesatzswächter to cast! How did you manage it all on your own?!

steps.name: 'Witch King's Echo'
steps.text: I... ugh!

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: The harmony of the Güldenesgesatz is inviolable.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: Today, no one outside Ludwigs-Universität will hear a single discordant note.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: I swear by my flesh, blood, and soul—

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: Not a single remnant of the Witch King will leave this spire alive. You and your Arts must be extinguished here.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: The melody's changed again.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Gerhard.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Took you long enough, Professor.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: I'm sure killing us Leithanian casters would be a simple matter for you.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: But as always, you're unwilling to dirty your own hands.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: How many times do I have to tell you? Us Liches are just the keepers of the palace of knowledge.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: We bring our wisdom to the different races to advance the development of Arts, but we never interfere with a country's own affairs. That was the Court of the Lich King's contract with your ancestors, and it is the Liches' creed.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: I understand all too well. A group of Sarkaz living in Leithanien's most ancient spire, the seat of her power—No Leithanian would willingly accept that truth.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: I'm quite jealous of you, you know. Even against Herkunftshorn, all you did was provide the enchantment that molded those twins.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: You didn't need to bear the responsibility of changing history, nor did you stain your hands with... the blood of your closest friend.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: I don't get what you're thinking at all. Years ago, you're the one tried to convince me to stop Herkunftshorn, but now you're mingling with these third-rate wannabes!

spans.text: I don't get what you're thinking at all. Years ago,
the one tried to convince me to stop Herkunftshorn, but now you're mingling with these third-rate wannabes!

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Ja, because I changed. And you're the one who changed me.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: You had me research the Güldenesgesatz and think on Leithanien's history. And I did exactly as you asked.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: But the deeper I got into my research, the more I... despaired.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Herkunftshorn's accomplishments were simply too dazzling.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: He resolved the Siracusan problem and saved Leithanien when it was on the verge of breaking apart. He crushed Corsica I and prevented us from becoming a Gaulish vassal state.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Only through his presence have we thwarted every existential threat to the country, again and again.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: We had such a great man on the throne, and... we killed him.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: When did I ever tell you to read up on how great Herkunftshorn was?

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: Besides, what does his 'greatness' have to do with him killing so many Sarkaz and Leithanians alike, turning the country into a smoking hot mess, and plugging his ears to anyone else's opinions?

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: I had you study the Güldenesgesatz because I wanted you to have a more open-minded outlook. Not to pour over every trivial growing pain every nation goes through. Hardships happen, then everyone goes back to their lives.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: But somehow you ended up caught up in this nonsense. How can you even consider this when so many have died?

spans.text: But somehow you ended up caught up in
nonsense. How can you even consider this when so many have died?

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: ...Because I can't see them, Professor.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: I'm not like you, a Sarkaz with control over even death itself. When we die, that's it. We become a speck of dust on this land forever. The dead can never feel my hatred.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: All those years ago, I was the one who persuaded them to fight. I sent them to their deaths in the Witch King's spire. If that battle had never happened, he wouldn't have died, and neither would they.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: You idiot. And that's why you want to resurrect him?

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: You can't possibly think that, when you do see him, he's going to praise you for this? Or even comfort you? He wasn't some kindly old grandfather who sang nursery rhymes to dumb kids!

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: He wouldn't even spare you a glance. He'd treat you as a speck of dust dirtying his floor.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Ha... Haha... You still don't understand a thing.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: A selfish and cowardly man like me...

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: Everything I do... I do to seek my own forgiveness.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: That thing you're holding... The missing Güldenesgesatz?!

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: More precisely, it's the lingering trace of Herkunftshorn's power he left in the Güldenesgesatz.

steps.name: Fremont
steps.text: You want to use his Arts by force? Don't be stupid, Gerhard! You can't do it!

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: I've come too far not to.

steps.name: Gerhard
steps.text: I don't want... to regret this a second time.
A flame rises, so black and so red that it seems drenched in blood.
The walls of the chamber tremble violently. Originium crystals sprout and grow from every crevice between the brick and tile, even piercing the ground's foundation.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Ugh... Argh...

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: Ebenholz!

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: Hurry, Gerhard's going to destroy this whole school!

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Witch... King...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: The Voice of Mundane... It's boiling in my head. It... It'll be free soon...

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: That's not the Voice of Mundane reacting.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: It's... not?

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: I don't know who first got it wrong. Or maybe Gerhard has given up on summoning him through you entirely.

steps.name: Lessing
steps.text: But Herkunftshorn's power isn't originating from your mind. You aren't the key melody here!

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Arturia.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: You're a little later than expected.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Is it because you were helping the Gendarmerie? You've grown soft. What happened to the executor who would stop at nothing to fulfill his mission?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: The fourth sculpture.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: You aren't playing.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: You must be shocked, aren't you?

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Like I've told you, you don't need to rush to find me. Until my real audience arrives, I'm just a listener myself.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: You aren't the source of the illusions the men below are experiencing.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: I'm a little hurt. We've been competing against each other for how long now? But you still confuse the 'truth' my music draws out with the 'illusions' a conman would use.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Besides, haven't you noticed? The people trapped in this spire have always hated each other. They've never stopped fighting.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Isn't laying the blame for this chaos entirely on mind-affecting Arts also a form of running away?

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Leithanien's affairs are not within the purview of the Notarial Hall. My primary targets are limited to you and your accomplices.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Who is manipulating the sculptures to protect you?

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: An avid listener of mine.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: You arrived a bit too late. Just a little earlier and you could also have had a front row seat to Der Tod des Hexenkönigs.

spans.text: You arrived a bit too late. Just a little earlier and you could also have had a front row seat to

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: The fifth.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: Arturia, I'm well acquainted with every crime you have committed. Your Arts have affected a variety of regions and social classes, but you have never actively participated in political conflict.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Do you remember my mother's funeral?

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: How I freed the emotions everyone had kept hidden in their hearts. It was the first time I realized how easily others fell into my melodies.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: But that brought me no joy. Quite the opposite. I was disappointed.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Powerful emotions should give rise to more than just chaos. Emotions are meant to bolster our souls, to allow us to overcome any obstacle... even our predestined extinction.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Which is why I came here in my search.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: The sixth.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: If you're looking to perform for the Witch King, then you will never succeed. He perished long ago. Your melody has no effect on the dead.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: It would seem you're a little mistaken about this performance.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: The shadow over the throne was dispersed, and the twin heroes walked out of the spire to the adoration of the masses... While those who stayed put are still waist deep in the emotions they felt when they witnessed the mountain crumble before them.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Der Tod des Hexenkönigs isn't about the Witch King. He was never the main character of this piece.

spans.text: isn't about the Witch King. He was never the main character of this piece.

steps.name: Flustered Student
steps.text: What happened... Why are we here? Ugh, my hand hurts! Why am I bleeding?

steps.name: Anxious Student
steps.text: The stairs are shaking! Is the spire coming down? What's with the black fire burning from the ground... Help! Help!

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: These are Herkunftshorn's enchantments. You've all come to your senses... We need to get out of the spire, now!

steps.name: Gendarmerie C
steps.text: Ngh... guh...

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: You're awake too?

steps.name: Gendarmerie C
steps.text: Candlelight... Candle... Can...

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Candlelight?

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Here, this way.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: But the flames... The whole Sonata Spire is enveloped by these black flames!

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: I'll open up a path.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: With your candle's flame?

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Pay attention to the shadow it casts on the wall.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: The shadow's... tearing the black flames apart?

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Ja... This is the true form of my Arts.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: You must be disappointed. They're not nearly as beautiful as you thought, right?

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: No, meine Dame... This is stunning.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: You don't often see Arts that can rival Herkunftshorn's undying black flames.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: I can't defeat them.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: But as long as something truly exists, it casts a shadow. The most I can manage is make use of this principle to ever-so-briefly create a chance to survive.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Is something the matter?

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: I was just thinking that... I was your enemy until a moment ago, yet you aren't blaming me.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Why should I?

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: You said you're not an Empresses' Voice. And I have yet to formally enter the Kaiserin's Spire myself.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Here, you can just be you, and I can just be Viviana. We aren't carrying out the Kaiserin's orders. We're simply helping out the poor souls struggling in this music.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: So please take the students and make your way out as fast as you can, while they've recovered their mobility. I can still hold on a little longer.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: I can see golden light outside. The Gesatzswächter's curtain has already enveloped this place. He could destroy the spire at any moment.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: I trust that Herr Reiner will make the appropriate decision.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: What about you, then?

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: My candleflame will extinguish sooner or later. Hopefully, it chooses the most meaningful moment to.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: Frau Hochberg... Viviana!

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Go, Michael.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Please take care of yourself and these young students. Each of you has a future that... someone like me could never dream of.

steps.name: Imperial Caster
steps.text: This is the place.

steps.name: Imperial Caster
steps.text: Surround the spire.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: Casters from the Kaiserinnen's Spires?

steps.name: Cora
steps.text: That's right, Brandt.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: Haven't I already said that—

steps.name: Cora
steps.text: These are the Kaiserin's orders.

steps.name: Imperial Caster
steps.text: We are to assist you in resolving the problem here.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: Good. Use your Arts. Join me as an accompaniment.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: I will tighten the curtain.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: No, Herr Reiner!

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: Step aside, envoy of Grimmacht.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: Will you continue to stand in our way? Your earlier behavior alone is reason enough to suspect you of colluding with the Witch King's remnants.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: There are still innocents inside.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: I see the students have all been evacuated, and Herr Fremont wouldn't die so easily.

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: But the Sankta, and Viviana...

steps.name: Cora
steps.text: Viviana is still inside?

steps.name: Michael
steps.text: She's trapped by the black flames, and stayed behind to save me and the students.

steps.name: Cora
steps.text: Brandt!

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: This is our best chance to eliminate the threat.

steps.name: Cora
steps.text: Once the ensemble is complete, your strength will completely annihilate the spire! Viviana will perish too!

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: It was her decision to enter the battlefield.

steps.name: Cora
steps.text: Werner gave his life for Leithanien. We can't let his one and only daughter follow in his footsteps!

steps.name: Cora
steps.text: You promised Werner that you'd save her. We both did. Have you forgotten your oath?

steps.name: 'Gesatzswächter'
steps.text: Have you forgotten your oath, Reiner?

steps.name: 'Gesatzswächter'
steps.text: The blade and Arts of a Gesatzswächter belong only to the Güldenesgesatz and to Leithanien.

steps.name: 'Gesatzswächter'
steps.text: It doesn't matter how Herkunftshorn treats his subjects. He is Leithanien's rightful ruler, as recognized by the Güldenesgesatz.

steps.name: 'Gesatzswächter'
steps.text: If you choose to fight alongside House Hochberg, you will be abandoning your duties as a Gesatzswächter.

steps.name: 'Gesatzswächter'
steps.text: One more step, and you will be making an enemy out of all of us.

steps.name: 'Hochberg'
steps.text: Brandt... Why didn't you come save us?

steps.name: 'Hochberg'
steps.text: We grew up together. We were like brothers.

steps.name: 'Hochberg'
steps.text: I know you loathe the Witch King too. You despise his tyranny over Sturmland's citizens, and you hate how he turned our homeland into a battlefield and a testing ground!

steps.name: 'Hochberg'
steps.text: The Battle of the Four Emperors was years ago, and the skies above Sturmland are still filled with Catastrophe clouds formed by Originium shards. Many of our children are doomed to be born with those accursed stones.

steps.name: 'Hochberg'
steps.text: Why can't we resist? Why can't we make him pay the price?

steps.name: 'Hochberg'
steps.text: Is it because the Güldenesgesatz dictates that he's the ruler, and that we are his attendants?

steps.name: 'Hochberg'
steps.text: Nein! It isn't right for us to be born that way.

steps.name: 'Hochberg'
steps.text: If your power is merely dependent on some inviolable will, does that make your will—the Gesatzswächter's will—fundamentally a lie?

steps.name: 'Hochberg'
steps.text: It's that lie that's forcing you run away from your decision.

steps.name: 'Hochberg'
steps.text: As well as from your remorse toward the dead Hochbergs.

steps.name: Gesatzswächter
steps.text: ...Viviana.
His body wobbles once, almost unnoticeably.
Then, small cracks start appearing in the golden curtain.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Resonance.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: At last... I got you.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: The seventh.

steps.name: Federico
steps.text: All the sculptures have been destroyed. You no longer have a means to resist.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Just a moment longer, my dear Federico.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Do you hear that?

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: Brandt Reiner. His soul is finally opening up to my melody.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: His strong will has finally broken free of his restraints, and the surge of emotions will lead him to make the decision he will regret the least.

steps.name: Arturia
steps.text: This is what I've been waiting for... The truest climax of this piece.
A melody, so impassioned that it approaches piercing, rings out from the strings of Arturia's cello.
As though motivated by the music, black Originium flames rise from the deepest depths of the earth and tear asunder the surface mere inches away.
The Witch King's musicians standing guard at the foot of the spire all walk single file into the black flames, chanting even as they are incinerated into ash.

steps.name: 'Witch King's Echo'
steps.text: The very Spire that holds up the skies, the inevitable, indispensable, and eternal pillar—

steps.name: 'Witch King's Echo'
steps.text: Now rise!
Something bores out of the earth's flesh.
It is a high spire.
It bears a red tint to its blackness, a spiral shape, and a strange sharpness.
The long lost Witch King's Spire stands atop the land once more.
